name: Mary's Land Farm
blurb: One booking platform for farm stays, events and experiences.

caseStudy.summary: A booking experience for farm stays, venues and activities, each with different availability and pricing rules.

sections.label: BOOKING EXPERIENCE
sections.title: Different farm experiences, one place to book.
sections.body: The site brings stays, events and activities together, with availability and pricing shaped around each experience.

sections.label: CUSTOMER + ADMIN FLOWS
sections.title: A smoother path from discovery to reservation.
sections.body: I worked on responsive booking and admin interfaces, connecting customer reservations to a shared operations workflow.

problem: Stays, events and activities each had different booking rules. The farm needed one place for customers to book and staff to manage reservations.

thinking.intro: I worked on customer booking and admin flows around shared reservation data, while accounting for the rules of each experience.

built.intro: Built responsive booking and admin interfaces in React and TypeScript, connected to Supabase and Stripe.

caseStudy.outcome: Customers can book different farm experiences through one platform, while staff manage reservations in a shared admin workflow.
